change: WifiNative uses direct wlan0 commands, unprefixed supplicant events are routed to wlan0, stable SCAN_RESULTS output is converted for Android 4.4, and empty events preserve the last valid AP list. T1-only trustedAp/autoConnect/needLogin/hiddenTrusted variables are skipped so the legacy supplicant can save and select standard WPA/WPA2 networks; Wi-Fi Direct is absent on HD2
